g1_1_business.what_it_does: Shaily Engineering Plastics Limited specializes in the manufacturing of precision engineering plastics, focusing primarily on healthcare applications such as drug delivery devices. The company is a key player in the production of pen injectors for GLP-1 therapies, which are used in the treatment of diabetes and obesity. By leveraging its expertise in engineering and regulatory compliance, Shaily has established itself as a leader in the healthcare CDMO (Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization) sector.

customers.description: Companies that require drug delivery devices for their products.
Brands that utilize precision components in their products.

manufacturing.description: Main manufacturing hub for pen injectors and other healthcare devices.
New facility expected to enhance production capacity for healthcare devices.

competitive_advantage: Strong regulatory certifications that take years to replicate.
Established relationships with major pharmaceutical companies.
Proprietary designs and technology in pen injector manufacturing.
Significant market share in the GLP-1 pen market.
Ability to scale production rapidly in response to demand.

drivers.title: Doubling Pen Production Capacity
drivers.fact: Capacity being scaled from 40 Mn to 80 Mn pens in India + 75 Mn in Abu Dhabi.
drivers.why_it_matters: This expansion will allow Shaily to meet increasing demand for GLP-1 pen injectors, driving revenue growth.
